run_training: run distributed training for UniVLG model with config file and command line opts
build_model: build a UniVLG detection model from a detectron2 configuration node
build_optimizer: build a parameterized optimizer with backbone lr multiplier and weight decay settings
test_model: test and evaluate a trained UniVLG model on configured test datasets
create_ddp_model: create a DistributedDataParallel model wrapper for multi-gpu training
build_evaluator: build dataset-specific evaluators for 2D, 3D, or referential grounding tasks
build_train_loader: build a multi-task or merged training data loader from 2D and 3D datasets
build_lr_scheduler: build a one-cycle or detectron2 default learning rate scheduler for an optimizer
launch_slurm_training: launch distributed training on a SLURM cluster with configurable gpu and machine counts
